objective.subject: docs: route protected-path changes through pull requests
objective.body:
Direct development delivery had no rule for protected paths. A direct push
skips the verification-integrity job, which runs only on pull requests, so
an agent could add its own REVIEWED_EXCEPTIONS entry without code-owner
review. The rule sits in the direct-push bullet and points at the protected
list in verification-integrity.md instead of restating it.

MUST: a change to a path listed under Protected infrastructure in verification/verification-integrity.md goes through a pull request, unless the maintainer approves the direct push in the current session and the commit body quotes that approval.
MUST NOT: push a protected-path change to a development line on an approval the agent wrote itself.

Maintainer approval, this session: "optimize this, consider this is my approval" (approves this rule change).

assurance: SKIPPED. Scope: one bullet in a project-delivery reference, documentation only. It changes no library runtime contract and no behavioral evidence, so no required condition holds.
